plans.note: Section 7 is captioned 'Limitations of Liability' — review there for cap amount, mutuality and carve-outs (fraud, IP infringement, confidentiality, indemnity). Check whether the cap is one-sided in Contractor's favour.

Section 7 heading indicates only 'Indemnification of Contractor', i.e. a Clear Capital-gives indemnity. A Contractor-side IP/misconduct indemnity is likely missing; also scan Section 5 warranties for any infringement covenant before concluding.
No restrictive-covenant section in the outline; if any restriction exists it would sit in the purpose/scope language (Section 1) or survival wording in Section 6.
Check Section 1 (Purpose of Engagement) for any 'sole/exclusive provider' framing and Section 3 for exclusivity tied to compensation; otherwise absent, which is acceptable to us.
Pricing terms live in Section 3; look for any obligation on us to extend best terms to Contractor. An MFN running in our favour would not be flagged.

No dedicated personnel/non-solicit section appears; if present it would likely be embedded in Section 1 (staffing) or the survival provisions of Section 6. Check duration and general-advertising carve-out if found.

Section 6 (Termination) is the operative clause; confirm we have convenience termination on reasonable notice without penalty and that Contractor cannot walk mid-engagement leaving Services incomplete.

Term/renewal mechanics may sit in Section 6 or in the unnumbered term section not surfaced in the outline (Section 2 is not listed); check auto-renewal, notice window and any uplift before treating as absent.
No general/miscellaneous section is listed. Scan the tail of Section 7 and the preamble for a choice-of-law or arbitration reference; if none, the rule is missing.
No assignment/miscellaneous section in the outline; check Section 6 for change-of-control termination triggers and Section 7 tail for boilerplate before marking missing.

Section 4 (Ownership of Materials Related to Services; Acceptance) is the primary location — confirm work product vests in Clear Capital, no assignment of our data or pre-existing IP to Contractor, and check any retained-rights carve-back.
Any licence-back or licence of Contractor background IP will sit in Section 4; test for affiliate and contractor use rights and whether the grant is revocable at will.
Audit of our usage would most likely be tied to compensation/records in Section 3 or usage of materials in Section 4; likely absent in this services engagement.
Look in Section 7 (liability/indemnity) and Section 3 (late-payment or cancellation fees) for penalties payable by us; credits running to us are welcome and not flagged.

Section 5 contains Contractor's warranties plus an express warranty disclaimer — assess warranty duration, conformity to Specifications and remedy; Section 4's acceptance mechanic is the related remedy path.
No insurance section in the outline; check the end of Section 5 and Section 7 for any coverage covenant tied to indemnity before concluding it is missing.
Section 3 (Contractor's Compensation) is where any minimum hours, retainer or take-or-pay commitment would appear; Section 1 may state a committed scope.
Check Section 6 for post-termination obligations and Section 4 for delivery/return of materials and data; if neither provides wind-down assistance and data return, treat as missing.
